messages:
Alex K: Quick follow-up — we need to move the remaining postmortem actions from INF-5234 into the rotation/relinquish queue. Recurring pattern: cache eviction spike Tue 03:00 UTC. Who can own the "lower-priority" remediation (cache warmup + doc) so we can hand it back to oncall after implementation?
Maria D: I can pick up the cache warmup doc and the tests. Will need infra changes though. Can someone make the infra ticket? :thumbsup:
Samir P: I can be the RACI approver for the change. Put me as A, Maria as R, Jin as C, Alex as I.
Jin H: I'll create the infra ticket and scope it. Creating INF-5239 now for the KV cache TTL/rehydration work. Linking to the original: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5239 -> will include rollout checklist.
Maria D: Thanks Jin. I'll update the postmortem action list and attach the test plan. Proposed timeline: start next sprint (Mon), aim for a small canary in 2 weeks, full rollout in 4 weeks. Is that OK?
Alex K: Timeline sounds reasonable. Add a handback step to ensure oncall knows when ownership transfers back. Also add a regression alert in Redwood Console tied to the prompt set that surfaced this.
Samir P: Agree. For RACI clarity: Maria = R, Jin = E (executor infra), Samir = A (approver), Alex = I. I'll add that to the Jira ticket description.
OncallBot: Reminder: there is an outstanding postmortem action INF-5234 assigned to "postmortem pool". Please assign an owner or it will reappear in the weekly triage.
Maria D: I updated INF-5234 to link INF-5239 and created INF-5240 for the docs + runbook updates: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5240
Maria D: Quick checklist (added to INF-5240):
```
- R: Maria D (docs + tests)
- E: Jin H (infra TTL + warmup)
- A: Samir P (approval)
- I: Alex K (product context)
- Create canary config and monitoring dashboard
- Add regression evals and alert thresholds
- Handoff note for oncall rotation
```
Samir P: Please assign INF-5239 to Jin and INF-5240 to Maria. I'll review the canary plan once it's up.
Jin H: Assigned INF-5239 to myself, added estimated effort 3d and a dependency on infra-queue. Will ping infra-sre for slot.
Alex K: Thanks — Maria, once docs are in place, add the handback message for oncall and ping ops during handoff. We want the next oncall to be able to flip the toggle if needed.
Maria D: Will do. I'll add the handback template to INF-5240 and tag @ops.
OncallBot: Note: scheduled triage for these tickets is Thu 09:00 UTC. If owners are set, they will be removed from the backlog queue.
Alex K: OK — owners: Maria (docs/tests), Jin (infra), Samir (approval). Timeline: canary in 2w, full rollout 4w. I'll close the postmortem loop here and move the remaining tasks into the owner-relinquish queue. Thanks all :eyes:
Samir P: :thumbsup: keeping an eye on INF-5239/5240 and will review on canary start.
Jin H: I'll post the canary config and schedule infra slot by EOD tomorrow.
Maria D: Added handoff checklist and alerted ops in the ticket comments.
